Box Office: Welcome 3 Outperforms Cocktail 2 Amidst Shifting Collections

Two films, 'Welcome to the Jungle' (Welcome 3) and 'Cocktail 2', are currently competing at the box office. 'Welcome to the Jungle' has shown resilience, maintaining its performance into its second week. In contrast, 'Cocktail 2' has seen its earnings decline. The collections for both films are being closely monitored daily.
